data.subject: Local Ledger research for Truffle Hound
data.body:
Hi,

Your most recent 13F (period June 30, 2026) shows positions in AXR, OPBK, and MGYR.

AXR reported Q2 2026 revenue of $6.1M versus $17.9M a year earlier, down 66.1% year over year. (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6207/000110465926107084/0001104659-26-107084-index.htm)

I publish a free weekly issue from public records, never issuer-paid, and can offer a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
